{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit jumper, slim fit with a soft V-neckline, hip length, warm cream #efe3d0, merino wool
Pleated midi skirt, A-line, falling to mid-calf, deep forest green #35563f, matte crepe
Wool coat, single-breasted, straight cut, knee length, camel #c19a6b, wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, dark chocolate #4a2f22, smooth leather
Small shoulder bag, structured, cognac #8b5a3c, grained leather
Small hoop earrings, slim, soft gold #c9a24b, polished metal

Why it works: the look is neat and feminine without feeling too formal for a casual restaurant. Cream near the face is soft and warm, and the forest green skirt echoes her green eyes while setting off her copper hair. The pleated midi skirt moves nicely when she walks, and the low block heel keeps her comfortable from the walk to the table through dinner. The camel coat keeps her warm on an autumn evening and ties in with the brown leather accessories for a calm, harmonious palette."}
